name: Foundations
blurb: What AI actually is, how a model learns, where a probabilistic component belongs in a software system, and the honest list of what goes wrong.

name: How LLMs actually work
blurb: A language model is a next-token predictor. Tokens, embeddings, attention, the context window, sampling and training - each drawn, each with a dial you can turn.

name: Classic ML for engineers
blurb: When a regression or a gradient-boosted tree beats an LLM, how to evaluate a model honestly, and how to serve one without a data-science team.

name: Prompting & structured output
blurb: Prompts as versioned, tested code: roles, patterns that actually work, reliable JSON, reasoning budgets, and the first look at prompt injection.

name: Building with LLM APIs
blurb: Calls done properly: retries, streaming, tool calling, multimodal input, caching and batch, token budgets, and tracing from day one.

name: RAG & knowledge
blurb: Retrieval-augmented generation end to end: chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, grounded answers with citations, and how to measure it.

name: Agents & orchestration
blurb: Workflow or agent? The agent loop, tools done well, MCP, memory, multi-agent and human approval gates - and the failure modes of each.

name: Evaluation & quality
blurb: "It looks good" is not evidence. Golden sets, scorers, LLM-as-judge, regression gates in CI, online evaluation and red-teaming.

name: Production: architecture, security, operations
blurb: The reference architecture, the gateway, latency and cost engineering, OWASP LLM Top 10, privacy and governance, guardrails and running it on call.

name: Customising models
blurb: When to fine-tune and when not to; LoRA, distillation, small and local models, and adapting embeddings to your domain.

name: AI in the software lifecycle & capstones
blurb: Working with coding agents, designing an AI feature with an eval plan, team and process, frameworks - and four capstone builds.
